meta.title: compose several primitives into a scatter
meta.description: Four primitives and one terminal node build a complete placement pass: scatter with a guaranteed spacing, cut it to noise-defined regions, turn every point a random way, give every point one uniform random size, then spawn. Each step is a name from the catalog rather than a hand-built cluster of nodes, which is what keeps the graph readable and its behaviour documented. Note what varies: the scatter and the two write steps differ per instance, while the noise mask does not — two masks with the same params cut identically unless their `variant` differs.
